summary: The diff implements most requirements including admin delete buttons, Clear All functionality, data export, local storage caching, music player controls, music management UI, and a top-down shooter game. However, several key backend integrations are incomplete or missing, particularly for music upload storage and some security validations.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend storage and serving of uploaded music files (MP3, WAV) to all users
missing_requirements.reason: AdminMusicManager.tsx contains placeholder comments indicating backend music upload is not implemented. The component uses local preview URLs instead of backend storage. No backend methods for uploadMusic, getMusicUrl, or removeMusic are visible in backend/main.mo.

missing_requirements.requirement: Music changes propagate to all connected users within reasonable time
missing_requirements.reason: useMusicPlayer.ts polls every 30 seconds but the fetchMusicUrl function contains placeholder comments and doesn't actually fetch from backend. No real-time or polling mechanism for music URL updates is implemented.

missing_requirements.requirement: File uploads validated for type and size in backend
missing_requirements.reason: File validation only occurs in frontend (AdminMusicManager.tsx checks file type and 10MB limit). No corresponding backend validation methods are visible in backend/main.mo to enforce server-side security.
